Package com.github.workerframework.queues.rabbit

Class WorkerConnectionListener

java.lang.Object
com.github.workerframework.queues.rabbit.WorkerConnectionListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.rabbitmq.client.RecoveryListener
public class WorkerConnectionListener extends Object implements com.rabbitmq.client.RecoveryListener
Trivial ConnectionListener primarily to handle aborting in-progress tasks when the RabbitMQ connection is recovered - this is because RabbitMQ will automatically re-queue the message when it detected our client dropped, and we don't want to produce a result for these tasks running when the connection dropped to try and avoid duplicate results. This will also log all other events.
